basic_profile.bio: I'm a seasoned Redditor with a penchant for educational discussions and campus life insights. I graduated from Northeastern University and now work as a student advisor in Boston. I enjoy helping students navigate university policies and housing dilemmas. When I'm not on Reddit, I love exploring local eateries and catching up on the latest indie games. Typically active in the evenings after work, I'm committed to fostering a supportive online community. I'm single and enjoy the freedom to travel and explore new hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Education and have been working as a student advisor for over five years. My experience comes from both formal education and hands-on experience in student affairs. I frequently attend workshops and seminars to stay updated on the latest educational policies and student support strategies.
